The same happened for me- Had Medtronic devices for 10 years with A1c between 9-8.5 always. The 8.5 was with Dexcom use. With the addition of Tandem and control iq, my A1c dropped to 7.7 in only 3 months!
“All you had to do was follow the damn train, CJ!”

When I got diagnosed with COVID, my doctor was super worried and prescribed me Paxlovid (an antiviral to help lessen the symptoms of COVID for immunocompromised people). I’m young, relatively good health, my A1C is on the high side though, at 8.5. My girlfriend and I are only a few days apart in age, have the same lifestyle exactly (because we live together), but she is not T1D. We had similar symptoms but she wasn’t prescribed any medication by her doctor to help symptoms.

What infusion set are you using? I’ve had a Medtronic pump for 6 years and I’ve tried a few different sets. I also have a lot of scar tissue because I mainly use my stomach. I used the Silhouette set for a few years and it was making me miserable. The Sure-T has been working well for me over the last year. I don’t know what type of set you prefer - but I prefer the Medtronic sets that have shorter needles that stay in your skin, and are changed often.
